ARPEGGIO JAZZ ENSEMBLE TRIBUTE TO GIL SCOTT-HERON | FRI, SAT & SUN NOV 13, 14 & 15 | SHOWTIMES VARY BY DAY

November 13, 2026 until November 15, 2026

FRIDAY & SATURDAY SHOWTIMES 7:00PM & 9:30PM 

SUNDAY SHOWTIMES 6:00PM & 8:30PM

Founded by acclaimed bassist and composer Warren Oree, The Arpeggio Jazz Ensemble has established a lasting presence in the world of contemporary jazz through its signature sound known as “Undefeated Jazz.” For more than four decades, the ensemble has blended original compositions, jazz standards, world rhythms, and improvisational energy into performances that are both artistically sophisticated and deeply engaging.

 The ensemble’s sound moves seamlessly from intimate, reflective melodies to dynamic, rhythm-driven performances. This versatility allows Arpeggio to tailor performances for concert halls, festivals, educational programs, private events, and community celebrations.

 The core ensemble features Warren Oree (acoustic bass), Tracy Smith (drums), Doug “Pablow” Edwards (congas and percussion), Frank Butrey (guitar), and Michael Clay (saxophone). Known for its musical versatility and global influences, Arpeggio frequently expands its lineup to include additional instrumentalists, vocalist Sherry Wilson Butler, and distinguished international guest artists.
